segments.speaker: Dr. Mehta
segments.text: Okay, the main issue this week is the night shift gap on Saturday.

segments.speaker: Nurse Joy
segments.text: We are short two nurses from eleven to seven.

segments.speaker: Dr. Mehta
segments.text: Could we pull one nurse from the day ward?

segments.speaker: Nurse Joy
segments.text: No, the day ward is already at minimum staffing, that won't work.

segments.speaker: Admin Ravi
segments.text: What if we bring in agency staff for that night?

segments.speaker: Dr. Mehta
segments.text: Yes, let's do that, agency staff for Saturday night.

segments.speaker: Admin Ravi
segments.text: I'll call the agency and book two nurses by Thursday.

segments.speaker: Nurse Joy
segments.text: Also, someone should update the on-call rota on the intranet.
